name: Incubus

source.note: The 2024 Incubus (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block). Nightmare (a Bonus Action: Unconscious at 20 HP or fewer, otherwise damage) is entered as a special action; the curse on Restless Touch is a timed_curse rider.

traits.name: Succubus Form
traits.summary: After a Long Rest it can take the Succubus stat block instead.
traits.text: When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a Succubus and use that stat block instead of this one. What it wears or carries doesn't change.

actions.name: Restless Touch

params.effect: the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests

actions.summary: A touch that curses the target for 24 hours: no benefit from Short Rests.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Cha, DC 15: Disguise Self and Etherealness at will; Dream and Hypnotic Pattern once a day.
actions.text: Charisma is its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15), needing no Material components. At will: Disguise Self, Etherealness. 1/day each: Dream, Hypnotic Pattern.

bonus_actions.name: Nightmare

damage.when: otherwise, if the target has more than 20 Hit Points

bonus_actions.summary: Recharge 6. DC 15 Wis save by a creature within 60 ft: 20 HP or fewer means asleep for an hour, otherwise 4d8 Psychic.
bonus_actions.text: Wisdom saving throw, DC 15, one creature the incubus can see within 60 feet. Failure: if the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer it is Unconscious for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet takes an action to wake it. Otherwise it takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.

summary: A flying tempter: psychic touches that curse rest, spells of sleep and dream, and a nightmare that fells the weak.
